label: Evaluation of the Humoral Immune Response Following Two Doses of a Coronavirus Disease 2019 Vector-Based Vaccine During the Initial Rollout in Bangladesh.
summary: The rollout of coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) vaccination was crucial in addressing the pandemic in Bangladesh, with the ChAdOx1 vaccine being the primary vaccine administered to most of the population.
